items.text: Calibrate each sensor (or verify with a standard) before the first day.
items.why: The EPA SOP requires calibration 'prior to use on the day' each day not only before the first day and does not mention 'verify with a standard' as an alternative.

items.text: At the end of each day run a post‑calibration check (standard/zero) and record any drift.
items.why: The EPA SOP only says 'A post calibration check at the end of the day is performed to determine if the instrument drifted out of calibration.' It does not specify 'standard/zero' or 'record any drift'.

items.text: Re‑calibrate only if the check shows the sensor has drifted outside its stated accuracy; otherwise you can continue the next day without a full re‑calibration.
items.why: The EPA SOP does not specify any action after the end-of-day post-calibration check; it only says the check is performed to determine drift.
